definitions.hit_rate: Macro fraction of answerable questions with any annotated (source, literal quote) in the ranked prefix.
definitions.recall: Macro fraction of annotated gold source/quote pairs retrieved per answerable question. This is evidence-annotation recall, not answer completeness.
definitions.latency: Observed per-question retrieval_seconds, including on-demand indexing/loading; one observation per question/configuration.
definitions.failures: Infrastructure/retriever exceptions, distinct from gold-evidence misses. All six CLI runs completed every expected question with ok/empty statuses.
definitions.unavailable: null: no answerable gold evidence, absent question type, or unavailable measurement; never fabricated as zero accuracy.
